incident.description: Complainant received WhatsApp call from unknown number claiming to be SBI KYC officer. Was instructed to install AnyDesk. Accused gained remote access and transferred ₹1,50,000 via unauthorized UPI transactions.
Victim received email with fake SBI link. Clicked and entered credentials. Account drained via NEFT.
Victim invested ₹5 lakh in fake crypto app promising 40% monthly returns. App suddenly shut down, funds gone.

evidence_samples.description: SBI bank statement showing 3 unauthorized UPI debits
